title: How to Defeat Kuldra the God Eater SOLO | RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: Jacob Fox
description:
Kuldra the God Eater is defeated! In this RuneScape: Dragonwilds boss fight, I take on Kuldra in the Scorned Wilderness and defeat the final boss of the first saga completely solo.

For this fight, I used Tier 7 Obsidian Armour, a Lava Cape, and the Pharaoh's Sceptre to help keep the dragons at a distance. You don't actually fight Kuldra directly. Instead, you have to use the Anima Gun, which must be loaded with Anima Orbs.

The real challenge is managing everything happening around you. You'll need to collect Anima Orbs, keep the Anima Gun charged, repair the Anima Pylons, deal with the dragons, and survive Kuldra's attacks all at the same time.

It sounds like a lot, but honestly, the fight was surprisingly manageable. I did the entire Kuldra boss fight solo with about 6 sandwiches, 5 waters, and absolutely nothing but hope and prayers.

If you're preparing to fight Kuldra the God Eater, this gameplay should give you a good idea of what to expect, what gear I used, and how the fight works.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, boss fights, gameplay, updates, and tips!
